text.short: A pintxo and a pote — one drink — taken together, at a fixed price, in a fixed hour. Elko keeps one on Thursday and Friday, 4:30 to 6, at $5.
text.note: In the Basque Country it is a whole town's habit: a street of bars, one pintxo and one small drink at each, moving on. Elko does it in one room.
